typography: handwritten script headers with clean body
decoration: moderate — a few SVG blobs or grid lines
hero_layout: split — portrait/visual on one side, text on the other
hero_headline_scale: subtle — standard h1 size, nothing crazy
nav_style: fixed top bar — always visible on scroll
scroll_animation: minimal — subtle fade-up on sections (CSS only, short delay)
contact_style: map-themed — as if marking your location
spacing_density: tight — compact, lots of content visible
color_scheme: mixed — alternating dark and light sections
bonus_quirk: one section has an inverted color scheme compared to the rest
